title: Mass upper bound M_W(T) ≤ μ(W) for a representation with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| (parent step 10)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), μ a measure on ℝ^P and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n (MultiVector P n). Assume |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α for every x and every n-covector α, and T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) (Bochner integral) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). Then M_W(T) = T.massOn W ≤ μ(W) for every set W ⊆ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ) → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), T.massOn W ≤ μ W
